proposals.note: Z6-invariant block: two RY layers (tied across all 6 qubits) interleaved with two RZZ entangling layers on cyclic nearest-neighbour (k=1) and next-nearest-neighbour (k=2) pairs. All gates within each layer mutually commute, so the layer ordering is the only ordering constraint and the cyclic-shift generator [1,2,3,4,5,0] maps every gate to another gate of the same type and parameter, guaranteeing exact Z6 invariance. The k=1 RZZ propagates local edge information around the ring while k=2 RZZ adds chordal correlations needed to detect global connectivity cuts. Two RY layers separated by entanglement provide non-commuting rotations for richer state preparation. 4 tied parameters × 2 repeats × 2 layers = 16 effective parameter applications, balancing expressiveness with symmetry regularization.

proposals.note: Ring-CNOT block (6 CNOTs forming a 6-cycle) for local information propagation, preceded by per-qubit RY rotations (6 params) to process the edge-encoded state from the feature map, and followed by two CRZ cross-links (0-3, 1-4) to enable long-range entanglement needed for global connectivity detection. Hypothesis set to null: the fixed feature map encodes edges in a fixed lexicographic order, breaking any site-permutation equivariance of the full circuit, so no relabeling invariance can be claimed for the expanded circuit. 14 gates, 8 params, moderate expressivity matching the best prior dev-risk regime.

proposals.note: Cyclically-symmetric (Z6) block: 6 tied RY rotations create uniform single-qubit bias; 6 RZZ on distance-1 pairs and 6 RZZ on distance-2 pairs build path-length-1 and path-length-2 correlations matching the graph structure; 3 CRZ on distance-3 (antipodal) pairs capture long-range connectivity. All gates map to same-parameter gates under the 6-cycle, giving a verifiable relabeling invariance. 21 gates, 4 params — balanced expressivity vs. symmetry constraint for the connectivity task.

proposals.note: Cyclically symmetric block (S6-invariant under 6-cycle). Structure: uniform RY on all 6 qubits, RZZ on all 6 nearest-neighbor cycle edges (theta2), CRZ on same nearest-neighbor edges (theta4), RZZ on all 6 next-nearest-neighbor cycle edges (theta3). 24 gates, 4 tied params. The cyclic RZZ+CRZ pattern propagates connectivity information along the graph cycle; the next-nearest RZZ layer adds 2-hop reachability. Full cyclic symmetry ensures the block treats all node pairs equivalently, matching the graph-connectivity problem's S6 invariance. Differs from c0007 by using 6 CRZ (all cycle edges) instead of 3, and splitting RZZ into two distance classes with separate params.

proposals.note: S3-equivariant block (order-6 group on {0,1,2}, identity on {3,4,5}). All 15 RZZ pairs covered in 3 orbits (within-012, within-345, all 9 cross) with 3 params; 3 CRZ gates form one orbit under S3; 6 RY share one param. Diagonal gates (RZZ+CRZ) placed before RY so all within-group gates commute, guaranteeing exact equivariance regardless of gate ordering within each commuting subgroup. This matches the connectivity task's invariance under relabeling of any three nodes while keeping the remaining three fixed. 24 gates, 4 params, targets dev risk below c0007's 0.5964 by using full pair coverage with strict symmetry.

proposals.note: D6-equivariant block: 6 RY(t1) on all qubits, 6 RZZ(t2) on ring edges (i,i+1 mod 6), 6 RZZ(t3) on next-nearest edges (i,i+2 mod 6), 6 RY(t4) on all qubits. Both RZZ layers use symmetric two-qubit gates so the dihedral group D6 (cyclic shift + reversal) is exactly realized: ring and next-nearest edge sets are each invariant under both generators. This gives true equivariance (zero channel residual) unlike the previous proposal whose CRZ gates broke reflection symmetry. The two-edge-radius RZZ entanglement lets the 21 Z_iZ_j readout observables detect connectivity paths at distance 1 and 2, while 4 trainable angles and 2 layers x 2 repeats provide sufficient expressivity. The D6 symmetry (order 12) matches the graph-connectivity label which is invariant under all node relabelings.

proposals.note: 24-gate block: 6 RY (uniform theta1) + 3 within-pair RZZ (theta2) + 12 between-pair RZZ (theta3) + 3 within-pair CRZ (theta4). Partition {0,3},{1,4},{2,5} defines the symmetry: the 6-cycle (0,1,2)(3,4,5) cycles the three pairs and (0,3) swaps within a pair, generating Z2^3 semidirect Z3 of order 24. All RZZ pairs are present (full K6) so any permutation preserving the partition maps the gate set to itself. CRZ on the three within-pair edges is likewise preserved. Connectivity is invariant under all of S6, hence under this subgroup. Structure mirrors best prior (c0010) but splits RZZ into within/between-pair groups to make the equivariance verifiable.
